scope: Whether the room sweep's step could have stepped over a neighbour

method.what_decides_it: the band of travel over which a neighbour is in contact, not its thickness: a part is stepped over only when that band is shorter than the step
method.thickness_note: thickness is reported because it was asked for; it bounds nothing on its own, since the cable is 56 mm across and adds its own width to every meeting

what_this_does_not_give: anything about directions the sweep did not take
a guarantee for a step finer than 1 mm, which was not tried
any judgement of whether the room found is enough

as_published.why: the figures the design side carries come from this view, so the step is checked in it
